name: Mage
description: A wielder of arcane destruction who obliterates enemies with devastating elemental magic.
lore: Graduates of the Obsidian Spire academy command fire, ice, and lightning with lethal precision. What they lack in durability, they more than make up for in sheer destructive power.

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.description: Hurls a bolt of raw arcane energy at a single target.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.description: Launches an explosive fireball that deals fire damage to all enemies.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: Releases a wave of frost that deals ice damage and slows all enemies by 50% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Strikes one enemy with lightning that chains to 2 additional targets at 60% damage.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.description: Converts incoming damage to MP drain at a 2:1 ratio for 3 turns. Breaks if MP reaches 0.

abilities.name: Arcane Mastery
abilities.description: Passive: All magic damage increased by 15%. Regenerate 5 MP per turn.

abilities.name: Meteor Storm
abilities.description: Ultimate: Calls down a devastating meteor storm for massive fire damage. Burns for 5% max HP/turn for 3 turns.

synergies: Warrior: Taunt keeps enemies off the fragile Mage while they cast freely
Cleric: Healing offsets the Mage's poor survivability
Rogue: Frost Nova slow counts as a debuff for Ambush bonus damage
weaknesses: Extremely fragile — lowest HP and physical defense
MP-hungry — extended fights drain resources fast
Useless when silenced or out of MP
hire_description: A robed figure idly levitates a flame between her fingers, looking bored. "Point me at something that needs to stop existing and we'll get along fine."
